CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 North Rexford Drive
  Room 280A
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210
  The Beverly Hills City Council Liaison /
  Finance and Audit Committee

  SPECIAL MEETING HIGHLIGHTS

  Monday, August 5, 2024
  2:40 PM
MEETING CALLED TO ORDER
Date / Time:  August 5, 2024 / 2:40 PM
IN ATTENDANCE:  Mayor Lester Friedman, Councilmember Mary Wells, City Treasurer
  Howard Fisher, Assistant City Manager Ryan Gohlich, Deputy City
  Manager Keith Sterling, Director of Finance Jeff Muir, Assistant Director
  of Finance Tatiana Szerwinski, Planning & Research Analyst Sivan Levin,
  Executive Assistant Vanessa Catullo, Crowe Audit Partner Jeff Jensen,
  Crowe Audit Senior Manager Joseph Widjaja, Founder/Managing Partner
  Mark Shuster, Partner/Chief Sales Officer JoAnn Parrino, Chief
  Investment Officer Cristopher Borden, Operations Manager Sarah
  Yauchzee, & Investment Analyst Michael Gonzalez

  1) PUBLIC COMMENT

  Members of the public were given the opportunity to directly address the Committee on
  any item listed on the agenda.
  None.

  2) AUDIT COMMUNICATIONS FOR THE FY2023-24 FINANCIAL STATEMENT AUDIT.

  Discussion of Audit Objectives and Scope:
  •  Perform an audit of the City’s Annual Comprehensive Financial Report in
  accordance with auditing standards generally accepted in the US (GAAS) and
  generally accepted government auditing standards (GAGAS) in order to express
  an opinion on the Financial Statements.
  •  Include a consideration of internal controls over financial reporting, without
  expressing an opinion on the effectiveness of such internal controls.
  •  Plan and perform the audit to obtain reasonable, rather than absolute,
  assurance about whether the financial statements are free of material
  misstatement.
  •  Perform an audit of the Schedule of Expenditures of Federal Awards and related
  internal control/compliance testing (will be required).
  •  Performance of procedures related to the Appropriation Limit.
   CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 North Rexford Drive
  Room 280A
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210
  The Beverly Hills City Council Liaison /
  Finance and Audit Committee

  SPECIAL MEETING HIGHLIGHTS

  Monday, August 5, 2024
  2:40 PM
  Discussion of Audit Plan and Timeline:
  •  Planning, internal controls review, audit procedures, & reporting.
  •  Testing is designed to address risks.
  •  The financial statement audit is expected to be finalized in November-December
  2024 and single audit expected to be finalized by the end of January 2025

  Financial Audit Reports to Be Completed:
  •  Independent Auditor’s Report for the year ending June 30, 2024.
  •  Report on Internal Controls over financial reporting, compliance, and other matters.

3) UPDATE FROM SHUSTER CONSULTING GROUP ON SECTION 115 TRUST
  INVESTMENT PORTFOLIO.

  Mark Shuster of Shuster Consulting Group provided an overview presentation of the
  OPEB and pension trusts including current trust portfolios and investment strategies.
  Cristopher Borden, Chief Investment Officer, shared information about current and
  projected market conditions and other considerations for investment strategies. The
  Section 115 Trust Investment Committee discussed and agreed to align the pension
  investment strategy (formerly 30% equity/70% fixed income) with the pension trust’s
  investment strategy (40% equity/60% fixed income) and move both trusts into the
  following composition:

  •  Equity: 40%
  •  Fixed Income: 50%
  •  Alternatives: 10%

4) ADJOURNMENT

  Date/Time: August 5, 2024 / 3:44 PM
